newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Worldwide sees FY96 loss.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Worldwide sees FY96 loss.

text.p: Johnson Worldwide Associates Inc said Monday it expects to report a loss for the year ended September 27 in a range of $1.20 to $1.30 per share.
The company cited inventory writedowns and an expected loss on one of its businesses.

Johnson Worldwide said inventory writedowns will occur across all of its recreation product lines, but the bulk will be taken in its fishing product line. The company's fourth quarter, historically a loss quarter, will reflect the added impact of these actions.
Chairman Samuel Johnson said the company took the writedowns after reviewing product turnover.
Johnson Worldwide manufactures and sells diving equipment, electric motors and outdoor equipment.
